column1: # GEN -- `gen(spec: map) : annotation`: an annotation that says how the value
# it meets is written where the document is generated. It is `any` carrying
# a record, so the meet leaves the value as it is and the record rides the
# result, through meets, reference copies and spreads. Two records unify as
# maps, and a disagreement refuses with gen_conflict. A record must unify
# with the standard options of its value's type, which the bundled model
# aontu:gen holds, and one that does not refuses with gen_option. The
# options are read at generation only: every other reading of the value is
# of the value. Every expectation is both engines' agreed answer.
# `significant: n` rounds a number to n significant digits where it is
# generated: the decimal the number shows, a tie to the even digit, in the
# number's own leaf. A float is the double nearest the rounded decimal.
# A tie goes to the even digit, and the number rounded is the decimal the
# float shows: 0.15 is a tie, where its binary value is a little below one.
# An integer rounds exactly and is written digit for digit, also where no
# The exact leaves round exactly, and a bigdecimal keeps its one place.
# The default writes every digit, a count past the digits changes nothing,
# and a float whose rounded decimal no double holds is refused where it is
# Canon writes the annotation after the value it rides, as the last term
# of its meet whatever order the terms were written in, and inside the
# other riders. An empty record leaves nothing.
# The record rides the value: a reference copies it, a spread applies it to
# each member, a preference keeps it for the value that overrides it, and a
# value computed from an annotated one carries none.

column3: m: {&: number & gen({significant: 2})}, m: a: 1.234, m: b: 5678
s: type({money: gen($.rec)}), rec: hide({significant: add(1, 1)}), p: $.s.money & 1.255
p: $.s.money & 1.255, rec: hide({significant: add(1, 1)}), s: type({money: gen($.rec)})

column1: # The statements of one document in three orders (ADR-081).

b: $.a, a: 1.2345, a: min(1), a: float & gen({significant: 2})
a: 1.2345, b: $.a, a: gen({significant: 2}) & float, a: min(1)

column1: # Two annotations on one value unify their records as maps.

column3: v: float & gen({significant: 2}), v: gen({significant: 2}), v: 1.2345
v: float & gen({significant: 2}), v: float & gen({significant: 3})

column1: # Two arms that differ only in their records are two arms.
# Two defaults of one rank that differ in their records are two defaults, and
# clash whichever arm is written first; a default of the lower rank stands.

column3: v: (*1.255 | float) & gen({significant: 2}), v: (*1.255 | float) & gen({significant: 1})
v: (*1.255 | float) & gen({significant: 1}), v: (*1.255 | float) & gen({significant: 2})
